scopeNotes: New text needs independent review; earlier hashes do not certify it.
Map endpoints are not historical founding or extinction dates.
Hanson’s reported 925 to 1485 occupation is an approximate site chronology, not an ethnic founding or ending. Later intermittent use is explicit.
The museum knife is catalogued as metal, not specifically copper. Acquisition around 1909 is not a manufacture date.
The net photograph and caption were inspected; no image is republished.
Miller’s purposive sample includes Ahtna and other residents; its findings are not generalized to every community or converted into travel advice.
Modern Tribal governments and Alaska Native corporations are distinct institutions.
The 1954 phase boundary marks the subsequent period of political organizing described on page 134 of the ethnography; it does not imply displacement effects ended then.
The imported polygon and 1492 snapshot remain unverified. Independent historical review remains outstanding.
